title: The 10 Best Smart Hose Timers
subtitle: Wi-Fi and app-controlled garden hose timers, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: We pulled the smart hose and faucet timers selling on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: Wi-Fi gateways, multiple zones, and brass fittings.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

awards.label: Best Overall
awards.name: GoveeLife H5901 with gateway
awards.why: Weather-adaptive watering, a brass inlet, a 1,640 ft. gateway range, and 800+ bought last month, for $49.99.

awards.label: Best Budget
awards.name: Insoma Wi-Fi hose timer with hub
awards.why: A $28.99 Smart Life timer with Alexa, Google, and Bluetooth fallback.

awards.label: Best Water Tracking
awards.name: RAINPOINT 2-zone with flow meter (HWG023 gateway)
awards.why: Two zones with a built-in flow meter and 12 months of water-use history, rated 4.9 stars.

awards.label: Best Multi-Zone
awards.name: Orbit B-hyve XD 4-port
awards.why: Four outlets on one faucet with weather-based adjustments, sold by Amazon.

systems_note: Smart Life / Tuya timers also have an official Home Assistant integration. Most timers here talk to a plug-in gateway over Bluetooth or their own radio; the gateway connects to Wi-Fi.

avoid.name: WiFi Sprinkler Timer 2 Zone, Smart Water Timer for Garden Hose Irrigation
avoid.flag: Can't decide whether it's 2 or 3 zones
avoid.verdict: The title says 2 zones, but the listing also calls it "this 3 zone sprinkler timer," so you can't be sure what arrives.
reasons: Title: "WiFi Sprinkler Timer 2 Zone." Bullet: "this 3 zone sprinkler timer featuring independent zone control."
No bullet lists what's in the box to settle it.
The same seller sells a 3-zone model, so mix-ups are likely.

buyers_guide.a: A hose timer screws onto an outdoor faucet to water gardens, drip lines, and hose sprinklers. An in-ground controller replaces the box that runs a buried sprinkler system.

buyers_guide.q: Why do some need a gateway?
buyers_guide.a: The timer at the faucet runs on batteries and uses Bluetooth or a low-power radio. A plug-in gateway inside connects it to Wi-Fi so you can control it away from home.
Bring timers inside before the first hard freeze. Water left inside can crack the valve.
